messages.subject: Extracting the cross-loading factors after a CFA with lavaan
parts:
Hello guys.

I need some help.

I need to extract all the loading factors from my model. I must to analyze the cross-loading criterion for assessing discriminant validity. When I use the inspect command, I get only the loading factor of the ítem on its own latent variable, but I need also the loading factors on the other latent variables.

messages.author: 5abdb409f213d464
messages.subject: Re: Extracting the cross-loading factors after a CFA with lavaan
parts:
I don't think you really need this. A CFA assumes that there are no cross-loadings (all cross-loadings are fixed to zero). You should therefore be able to recognize from a good model fit that this problem does not exist in a substantial way. In addition, you can carry out an ECFA: https://www.guilford.com/books/Confirmatory-Factor-Analysis-for-Applied-Research/Timothy-Brown/9781462515363
